component.name: EBC-A20 Battery Tester
component.summary: Touchscreen UI for the ZKETECH EBC-A20 battery capacity tester

description.p: A native touchscreen app for the ZKETECH EBC-A20 battery capacity tester: connect over USB-serial, run constant-current/constant-power discharge and constant-voltage charge tests with a live chart, and use the configurable multi-cycle charge/discharge Repeat mode. Also runs against a built-in simulator with no hardware attached.
